quirks.summary: A June 2026 validated-date search returns 'No results found' while September 2025 returns a full page -- an empty recent window here is not a portal fault.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-29: 1-30 June, 1-7 June and 1-2 June 2026 all returned no results on a live session, and 1-7 September 2025 returned 10 rows on a fresh session, with documents and a verified download. Whatever the cause, do not read an empty recent window as a broken portal or stop there.
quirks.workaround: Fall back to an older date window before concluding the search is broken.
